children: Robinhood Chain's DeFi total value locked is about $683 million, up 17.78% over the past week and the fastest growth among major blockchains. According to ChainCatcher, the network recorded $890 million in DEX trading volume over the past 24 hours, ranking fifth across all networks. It also generated $279,000 in fees during the same period, placing sixth overall.

title: Robinhood Chain DeFi TVL Rises 17.78% in a Week to $683 Million
